author: Omankar
quote:
The most overrated gaming experience I've ever had. I genuinely don't understand how people consider this the greatest video game ever made. The graphics are beautiful, the world is detailed and the characters are well written. Congratulations. Unfortunately, it's supposed to be a **** video game. The gameplay is painfully boring. Missions are ridiculously restrictive, constantly forcing you to follow predetermined routes and perform actions exactly as the developers intended. Having a different approach to an objective is a crime punishable by instant mission failure.

The combat is laughably easy, progression feels unrewarding and most of the open world activities are glorified chores. Hunting, crafting, collecting things and performing mundane tasks might impress someone who enjoys virtual employment, but I'd rather actually play a game. And the animations. Jesus **** Christ. Everything takes an eternity. Opening drawers, looting bodies, picking up objects and skinning animals. Rockstar seems to believe that making every interaction unnecessarily slow somehow makes it immersive. It doesn't. It makes me want to uninstall the game. The mission structure is particularly awful. Follow someone on horseback for 15 minutes, listen to endless dialogue, shoot a bunch of enemies and repeat. Occasionally the game even allows you to experience the revolutionary gameplay mechanic of WALKING.I genuinely cannot understand how people defend these design decisions. A beautiful open world doesn't automatically make an enjoyable game, and cinematic presentation isn't a substitute for meaningful gameplay. I've tried repeatedly to enjoy this game, and every time I come back I remember why I stopped playing.**0/10.** I'd give it a negative score if Metacritic allowed it. Never want to touch this **** game again.

author: Omankar
quote: After waiting all these years I can confidently say GTA 6 was not worth the hype.Rockstar has once again proven that impressive graphics and a ridiculously detailed open wrold cant compensate for gameplay that is just not **** same problems that plagued RDR2 are still here. Restrictive mission design, excessive scripted sequences, sluggish animations and an obsession with cinematic presentation instead of actual player **** before anyone brings up RDR2, yes I know its apparently the greatest masterpiece ever created. Beautiful graphics, incredible attention to detail and animations so unnecessarily elaborate that opening a **** drawer takes longer than some entire missions. Apparently watching Arthur ride a horse for 15 minutes is peak gaming.I want a bideo game, not a 50 hour movie where im ocasionaly allowed to press **** wrold might be beautiful but I didnt buy a game just to admire the scenery. I want meaningful progression, challenging gameplay and freedom of approach. Is that really too much to aks?Rockstar seems more interested in convincing me that im living in a virtual wrold than actually letting me play one.After all these years this is what we waited for? What a dissapointment. Should have spent my money on literally anything else.
